fieldNotes.siteDiscrepancy: Roster source cites 601,836 SF / 92 dock doors for the Kenco Allentown MCS site, but the building at the ROOFTOP-geocoded 6975 Ambassador Drive is a mid-size warehouse of roughly 150,000-250,000 SF with a modest single-face dock bank. The roster figure likely aggregates Kenco's total Allentown footprint or is mislabeled. Audited the physical building at the confirmed address; the '6975' address number is visible on the building wall in 2025-05 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled entrance. The site driveway connects to Ambassador Drive as an open driveway with no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint (2025-05 Street View + z19/z20 satellite).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth anywhere on the property.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single dock bank on the NW (back) face; estimated 10-25 doors from z19/z20 imagery — well short of the 92 the roster source cites.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Small open truck court along the NW dock apron; only a few trailers, no striped drop-yard stalls — banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Suburban industrial park (Iron Run / Trexlertown) at the edge of a residential area with farmland alongside; judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tiebreak.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Only one dock face observed; ship/receive separation not confirmed.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~6 trailers/equipment counted at the NW dock apron; approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimated 12; small open court, low confidence.
